name: NVIDIA NeMo
desc: NVIDIA's platform to build, monitor and optimise AI agents end to end.
desc_zh: 英伟达用于构建、监控和优化 AI 智能体的全流程平台。
solves: An agent that works on Monday quietly breaks by Friday. It gives you the tracing, evaluation and guardrails to see what changed.
solves_zh: 周一还好好的 Agent，到周五就悄悄坏了。它提供链路追踪、评估和护栏，让你看得见是哪一环变了。
best_for: When you run agents in production and need to know why one answer went wrong.
best_for_zh: Agent 已经跑在生产上，需要查清某次输出为什么出错的时候。
notes: The agent ops and guardrail layer enterprises bolt onto any model, including open-weight ones; date is approximate because the brand has been re-versioned repeatedly. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-data-science/products/nemo/
